pricing.name: Cursor models and pricing (markdown)
pricing.purpose: Authoritative source for per-model input / cache write / cache read / output prices and the canonical model list. Mintlify exposes the raw Markdown source at the .md URL — immune to frontend rebuilds and trivially parseable.

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (API)
benchmarks.purpose: Composite of ~10 evaluations including GPQA Diamond, Humanity's Last Exam (HLE), SciCode, Terminal-Bench Hard, AA-Omniscience, AIME, MATH-500. Reads the official AA Insights API instead of scraping the SPA. Requires AA_API_KEY in environment (free tier: 1000 req/day; sign up at https://artificialanalysis.ai/login). The transform also serves as the HLE source — AA's per-model evaluations include the HLE column, replacing the previous lastexam.ai scrape.

benchmarks.name: LMArena (HuggingFace parquet)
benchmarks.purpose: Human-preference Elo across general chat, coding, search, and webdev. Authoritative parquet snapshot maintained by the LMArena team on HuggingFace Datasets — bypasses the SPA leaderboard at lmarena.ai. The transform also fetches the webdev and search sibling subsets so claims like 'LMArena WebDev Elo X' and 'LMArena Search Elo Y' can be re-verified.

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench (raw JSON)
benchmarks.purpose: Real GitHub issues; SWE-bench Verified is the 500-instance human-filtered subset. Authoritative JSON file maintained in the swebench.github.io repo (master branch) — this is the data file the public leaderboard renders from. The transform filters to the Verified and Multilingual splits and trims per-submission fields to keep the payload under the prompt budget.

benchmarks.name: Aider polyglot (raw YAML)
benchmarks.purpose: Coding leaderboard across C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, Rust. Authoritative YAML maintained in the aider repo, free of SPA hydration.

benchmarks.name: MMMU (raw JSON)
benchmarks.purpose: Multimodal university-level understanding. Authoritative leaderboard JSON maintained in the github.io repo — this is the data file the public leaderboard renders from. ~90 KB, fits under the prompt budget without filtering.

benchmarks.name: τ²-bench (Sierra Research)
benchmarks.purpose: Agentic / tool-use benchmark with a real tool–agent–user loop across airline, retail, and banking domains. The transform reads the submission manifest, then fetches each per-submission JSON to get model identifiers + per-domain pass@k scores. Fills a gap in the source list — no other current source measures multi-turn tool-use directly.

benchmarks.name: LiveCodeBench (raw JSON)
benchmarks.purpose: Contamination-free coding benchmark with rolling problem updates from LeetCode / AtCoder / Codeforces. Complements SWE-bench Verified (which measures repo-level fixes) by measuring algorithmic problem-solving on problems the models could not have trained on. The transform aggregates the upstream per-question rows into per-model pass@1 averages by difficulty, mirroring what livecodebench.github.io computes client-side.
